title: VerifyCommentsInput
description:
What one `verify_comments` job reads besides the checkout. Every text from GitHub, an earlier LLM job or the
owner is untrusted data.

title.description: The PR title as its author wrote it.

description.description: The PR description as its author wrote it; none when empty.

pr_context.description: The PR context of the latest analysis (LLM text), if one exists.

project_profile.description: The project profile (`.claudius/project-profile.md` at the base of the latest analysis), if present.

earlier_decisions.description: The current decisions on other items of this pull request.

question.description: The owner's question in a question pass; its item is one of `items`.

location.description: Discussed lines: at the head for a thread, at `commit` for a review-body item.

commit.description: The commit the comment was written on (its bot round's head, else its review's commit); null when unknown.

bot_severity.description: The bot's own severity words, a claim.

bot_status.description: The bot's own status of its thread (thepastaclaw edits its comment), a claim.

replies.description:
The thread's replies after the comment, oldest first: the latest [`MAX_REPLIES`], each at most
[`MAX_REPLY_CHARS`] characters.

CommentItemKind.description: Where an item comes from (plan §2.1 I1–I4). Open enum.

oneOf.description: I1: a review thread.
I2: an item of a review body (no thread).
I3: an item of a human PR-level comment.
I4: a PR-level question built by the server from rounds (merge now, dismiss stale reviews).

AuthorKind.description: Who wrote the item: the bot rule (`Bot` type, `[bot]` login or Settings `known_bots`, RQ17).

oneOf.description: A person (also `claude` unless listed as a bot).
A bot by the bot rule.
The server (PR-level questions).

ItemLocation.description:
The lines an item discusses: at the head for a thread; for a body item naming `path:range`, at the review's
commit, which may predate the head.

lines.description: The lines; null for a file-level or outdated thread without a head line.

LineRange.description: Lines `start_line..=end_line`, 1-based, on the side given by the enclosing type.

BotThreadStatus.description:
thepastaclaw's own status of a thread, read from its status block (spike S13-1 M4); a GitHub fact, not a
decision. Open enum.

oneOf.description: "Resolved".
"Deferred (maintainer decision)".
"Withdrawn".
"No longer applies".
"Disputed (left to the maintainers)".

ThreadReply.description: A reply in an item's thread (untrusted).

body.description: Text without bot markup; a cut text ends with `…`.

oneOf.description: A person other than the pull request's author.
A bot by the bot rule.
The pull request's author (a person).

EarlierDecision.description:
A decision already made on an item of the pull request: in diffpilot, or recorded by a reply in the item's
thread.

decision.description: The decision made in diffpilot; null for one a reply records, whose text is `reason`.

reason.description: The owner's reason, if given, or the reply's text.

ReviewDecisionKind.description: A review decision (D1–D7 and P1–P4) eligible for external use.

oneOf.description: D1: resolve, already fixed.
D2: fix in this pull request.
D3: reject (with a reason); D8 with a `blocker_gate` override.
D4: handled in an existing pull request.
D5: create a follow-up pull request.
D6: upstream issue (link or create).
D7: TODO, out of scope for this pull request.
P1: merge now, remaining items become follow-ups.
P2: another round.
P3: dismiss the listed stale bot reviews.
P4: keep the reviews.

ItemQuestion.description: The owner's question about one item, with the earlier questions of its thread.

thread.description: Earlier questions of the same thread with their answers, oldest first.

ThreadEntry.description: An earlier question of a thread and its answer.

answer.description: The answer, if one was given.
